title: Haas confirm Rafael Camara to race for the team in Las Vegas as Ryo Hirakawa returns for FP1 appearance
paragraphs: Haas have confirmed that Rafael Camara will again race for the team at the Las Vegas Grand Prix – following on from his Formula 1 debut last time out at his home event in Sao Paulo – while Ryo Hirakawa is also set to get behind the wheel during Free Practice 1. title: IT'S RACE WEEK: 5 storylines we're excited about ahead of the 2026 Las Vegas Grand Prix
paragraphs: 20 races down, three to go. The 2026 Formula 1 season is set to kick off the final triple-header of the year, and even with the winners of both championships already decided, there are plenty of storylines to get excited about. Here are just a few of the talking points as the paddock heads to Las Vegas.

title: Las Vegas GP reveals neon-inspired trophy for 2026
paragraphs: The Las Vegas Grand Prix has unveiled a new trophy for its 2026 Formula 1 race, with a design inspired by the city's iconic neon signs and vintage illuminated marquees. The trophy is the second design used since the event joined the F1 calendar in 2023 and features a distinctive V-shaped silhouette, representing both Vegas and victory. title: Vegas gives Camara chance to put messy debut behind him
paragraphs: Haas's new signing Rafael Camara will get a quick chance to move on from his messy Formula 1 debut in Brazil as he will stay in the car for this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix.
